notes: Audit at main 6f63aaa, read-only. Key truths: (1) No payments foundation — Stripe is types-only, PAYMENT_PROVIDER_GATE='BLOCKED'; site00_invoices/leads/discovery_bookings are written only by a NORTHQUARTER demo seed. (2) Three client-callable paths mark work as paid/authorized without money (client-production activate-project sets payment_state CONFIRMED; marketing confirm-payment; identity-commercial authorize) — the only commercial CLIENT_READY_BLOCKER. (3) Courtesy codes are a real, tested engine (hash, windows, email/client restriction, max redemptions, comp/fixed/diagnosis/labor types) but memory-only, Existing-Location-only, eligible_services unenforced, no arbitrary percent, no stacking/credit/override/client price book. (4) Pricing is duplicated (EVOLVE dual trees, BLDR ×5, IDNTY labels) and the canonical Site00ServiceCatalog has cents only for EVOLVE; most fulfillment scopes are FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED (12 open FDs). (5) Business understanding is captured in ≥6 intake mechanisms and ≥6 profile stores; world intake is the richest (business model/revenue/audience/offerings) and IDNTY/BLDR intake persistence is the most mature; EVOLVE + creative intake are localStorage only. (6) Market intelligence is thin: no competitor research, audience/positioning are free-text in 3 stores, cultural intelligence is NDXBOOK-only. (7) Cost: no cost ledger table; OpenArt spend is manual repo JSON (JURNL), Opus receipts go to /tmp, fal costs scattered in jsonb; ≥7 spend guards with some ?? true defaults; margin view runs on fixtures; client credit UI fabricates numbers. Effort estimates assume one engineer familiar with the repo.
